note: Pike County has no county-wide zoning (county FAQ). Petersburg, Winslow and Spurgeon zone their own land per their codebooks, but the regional planning commission publishes only aerial and base PDF maps for them, and the city pages host no zoning map. No queryable ArcGIS/WFS/bulk zoning district layer was found in ArcGIS Hub/Online searches or web searches. The county GIS (pikein.wthgis.com, in.gov/gis) is a viewer with no identified zoning service.
